text:
Asha: quick postmortem follow-up for the late-night routing wobble that produced cross-region retries and DNS failovers. Need owners and short ETAs so we can close the loop.

Ben: short cause summary: an automated route-preference tweak sent traffic from ap-south to an older edge pool whose certs and SNI mapping were out of sync. LBs retried aggressively when TLS handshakes reset -> downstream 5xx spike.

Marco: logs: ```
[edge-old-1] 2026-08-02T02:14:11Z TLS alert: bad_certificate
[lb-main]   2026-08-02T02:14:12Z upstream reset, retries=2
```

Asha: Action 1 (owner: Marco) - rotate/verify certs on the legacy pool and post fingerprints to INC-5234. ETA 2026-08-02 16:00 UTC.

Marco: started rotation now, will attach CAPTUREs.

Ben: Action 2 (owner: Rina) - add a pre-change TLS gate to the route-change job that performs a real TLS handshake (from 3 regions) before committing changes. ETA 2026-08-09.

Rina: plan: reuse probe harness, add testrunner that validates SNI/cert chain and expected hostname. Will open PR.

Asha: Action 3 (owner: Ben) - create a short-term LB policy flag to suppress client-side retries for 20m after automated route moves. Implement as an opt-in toggle. ETA 2026-08-04. Note: risk = higher visible error rates for transient backends.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-5234 created: route-change-tls-failures. Link: https://tickets.redwood/INC-5234

Ben: Monitoring changes: add alert net.tls.reset_spike -> page if tls_resetrate > 0.4% for 10m AND lb_retries/s > 30 for 5m. Also add graph panel: retries_by_region. (owner: Ben) ETA 2026-08-05.

Asha: Runbook quick commands for oncall:
1) validate SNI: `curl -v --resolve api.redwood:443:1.2.3.4 https://api.redwood/health`
2) if TLS resets, flip retry flag: `lbctl set-retry-window --disable 20m`
3) rotate certs: `certctl rotate --pool POOL` and monitor. (owner: Marco for cert rotate)

Marco: I'll also add a smoke-test script that runs after any route-change to confirm TLS handshakes from 4 regions. ETA 2026-08-07.

Rina: Recurrence note: matches earlier incidents where config-driven route shifts lacked compatibility checks. Proposal: add a pre-change compatibility checklist item to the network change template requiring TLS handshakes from at least 3 regions. I'll update template. ETA 2026-08-11.

Asha: Final checklist from this thread:
- [ ] INC-5234 created (ops-bot)
- [ ] rotate certs on legacy pool (Marco) - ETA 8/02 16:00
- [ ] LB retry short-disable flag (Ben) - ETA 8/04
- [ ] monitoring alert + dashboard (Ben) - ETA 8/05
- [ ] smoke-test after route-change (Marco) - ETA 8/07
- [ ] pre-change TLS gate in route job (Rina) - ETA 8/09
- [ ] add checklist item to network template (Rina) - ETA 8/11

Ben: I'll update INC-5234 as tasks progress.

Marco: cert rotation complete, posting fingerprint to ticket now.

Rina: opening PR for TLS gate shortly.

Asha: thanks everyone — will run a 20m sync Thursday to confirm closures and then close this thread.
